rules.title: Residential rental application fee cap
rules.requirement: A landlord or agent may not charge an application fee above $50 (adjusted yearly by CPI). Overcharges are penalized and refunded to the applicant.
rules.key_value: $50 cap, CPI-adjusted each January 1; penalty up to $500/$750/$1,000
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental property leased or subleased for dwelling purposes
rules.exemptions: Dwelling unit in a one-family or two-family dwelling; New Jersey Real Estate Commission licensee unless the licensee is the landlord
rules.quoted_span: shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply

notes: Effective date computed from section 3 (first day of the fourth month after approval on 2026-01-20 = 2026-05-01). Annual CPI adjustment amounts are not in the text.
